name: Settlement or award funded by a party with no link to the dispute
description: The payment of a settlement or judgment comes from an unrelated third party, a newly created entity or an offshore account instead of the named respondent.
fp: Insurers, guarantors, parent companies and liability funds may legitimately pay on behalf of a respondent. Obtain the documentary basis for the payer.

links.name: Settlement or award funded by a party with no link to the dispute
links.ctx: Source-of-funds red flag on the receiving side, as the payer's identity does not match the legal record.
